adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a bug in the diff. Looking at line 147-149 in GoogleCalendarService.ts, the code `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` will return undefined when a destination calendar has no credentialId (legacy case), because the find() will never match. This causes the fallback to 'primary' calendar on line 152 (`calendarId: selectedCalendar || "primary"`). The createEvent function receives credentialId as a parameter, so when legacy destination calendars exist without credentialId, they won't be found and the event will be created in 'primary' instead of the configured destination. This is a real correctness bug.
